title: Connecting Your Platforms to Advanced SSPM

blocks.text: You can connect your platforms to Zscaler Advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) to continuously monitor and correct Software as a Service (SaaS) security posture and ensure regulatory compliance is maintained across the organization.
Connecting your platform to Advanced SSPM is dependent on your license. If you have questions regarding the license, contact your Zscaler Account team.
You can connect the following API-based platforms to Advanced SSPM:
For onboarding some of the API-based platforms, you are redirected to the Add SaaS Application Tenant page in the Zscaler Admin Console. To learn more, see Adding SaaS Application Tenants.

After a connection is achieved, it might take a while to pull and ingest all relevant application data depending on the size of your tenant. During this time, a message displays indicating that the integration is still being processed. After integration is completed, a success message appears, and the integration status, first connected time, and last synced time are updated on the Settings page. If the connection fails, an error message appears. Contact Zscaler Support if you require further assistance.
